title: epicharis pachyrhachis
intro: Epicharis pachyrhachis, commonly known as the "Golden Chalice Vine," is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Epicharis pachyrhachis include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antifungal and antibacterial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, phenolic compounds, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
